summary: Short main-road kerb with a house 13 m away and no parked cars.
reasons: Driveway and crossing break the kerb

drivers.seclusion: Two detached houses sit 13 and 14 m from the kerb; a school building is 25 m off.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is 23 m with a driveway and a red pedestrian crossing beside it; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Through road with moving traffic and no kerbside parking on this side.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this kerb and no marked parking lane.

flags: Low-lying: about 8.7 m, Sandy Creek 55 m away
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the east and north.
